sentences.text: Aaltoillen Kuntoutus Oy is a company registered on 2026-03-18 under the industry code 86990, other human health activities.
A start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-04-13, and first sales and a first hire are recorded on 2026-08-15.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a word that can mean waves in Finnish, but the registered industry is health activities and the record shows no ocean use.
